items.description: The Oklahoma coaching legend is not happy with the SEC after the league made the call to shift the conference showdown to Sunday
items.imageCaption: Getty Images
items.author: Brad Crawford
items.excerpt: Oklahoma coaching legend Bob Stoops is not happy with SEC commissioner Greg Sankey and the league's decision to move Saturday's Ole Miss-Oklahoma game to Sunday afternoon following the Rebels' request after flight restrictions this week. Hours after Sooners athletic director Roger Denny blasted the conference's move, Stoops took to social media to voice his displeasure. When Oklahoma attempted to keep the game Saturday, Sankey told the school that failing to play at the directed time would result in a forfeit.
